responsibility: Provides the generated/default multilib selection header for the RISC-V target when GCC is configured with `--with-multilib-list`. Rather than implementing code generation, it maps configure-time `TARGET_MLIB_ARCH` and `TARGET_MLIB_ABI` selector values to the `MULTILIB_DEFAULTS` macro, choosing the default `march=`/`mabi=` pair such as `rv32gc` with `ilp32*` or `rv64gc` with `lp64*`; this header is therefore the compile-time bridge between multilib configuration choices and the driver/spec logic in the rest of the RISC-V port.
